bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 100 日和 10 日均线，受制于 $203

read.en: Zscaler jumped 6.8% on Nov 18 to $197.83, trading $184.77–202.35. It reclaimed the 100-day ($186.6, rising), 5-day ($191.9) and 10-day ($194.9), both falling, and stays above the 200-day ($166.5); it is below the falling 30-day ($219.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 2 ($211.02), and RSI is 42.7.
read.zh: Zscaler 11月18日大涨 6.8%，收于 $197.83，盘中区间 $184.77–202.35。股价收复 100 日均线（$186.6，上行）以及均在下行的 5 日（$191.9）和 10 日均线（$194.9），并守在 200 日均线（$166.5）上方；仍低于下行的 30 日均线（$219.6）。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月2日起看空（$211.02），RSI 为 42.7。

read.en: The jump reclaimed all three resistance bands from $186.5 to $197.5 (100-day, 5-day, 10-day, Nov 13 high), now support; the $202.35 high stalled under $203. Resistance is $202.4–203.3 (Nov 11 high, Oct 16 low), then $210.5–211 (Nov 6 high, SAR) and $217–219.6 (30-day). Support is $194.9–197.4, then $186.5–191.9 and $180.5–184.8. A close above $203.3 would target $210–211; below $194.9, $186.5–192.

r.en: Nov 18 high $202.35; Nov 11 high $203.00; Nov 5 low $203.02; Oct 16 low $203.33

s.en: 10-day average $194.9, reclaimed; Nov 9 low $195.80; Nov 13 high $197.43
